title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager RemoteControlAuth Exposed Dangerous Method Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Ivanti Endpoint Manager. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the RemoteControlAuth module. The issue results from an exposed dangerous method. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
